discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic peptide discovery to drugs with huge effects on diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular outcomes. The work has already won the Lasker (2024), the Breakthrough Prize and the Gairdner, which are classic Nobel precursors. The 2025 immunology prize also makes a metabolic or endocrine topic more likely this year.
